scope: Engineering smoke; left-only objective-compatible value policy vs Greedy, paired Greedy-vs-Greedy control; no strength or PvP certification.

training.selection: final epoch only; one training attempt; no tuning

evaluation.policy: existing NnPolicy enumeration, one-ply afterstate argmax, known-terminal outcome override, first tied candidate
evaluation.control: both sides Greedy PlayStep, same ordered decks and seed
evaluation.admission: terminal Left/Right winner, no VM/unsupported/unimplemented/choice faults, no pending choices, all replay prefixes match; probe faults reject entire attempt
evaluation.outcomes: retain all attempts, no replacement/reseeding; paired Left-win delta only if both admitted
evaluation.budget: wall budget checked between synchronous calls; limits may censor expensive policy games; engineering smoke not strength evidence
evaluation.distributionLimit: Greedy before-decision training vs one-ply policy afterstates; observational contract compatibility does not establish identical distribution
evaluation.independence: new evaluation seeds, disjoint from all original training attempts and prior external-eval seeds
